mare.crossing: an ellipse whose light is scaled by 1 - depth in every channel; horizontal, alternating direction, on the middle, upper-third and lower-third rows in turn; its centre at the middle of each frame's stretch of the path; a window is the crossing and the frame after
mare.frameRate: 18.115 fps, the mean in FireCapture's log Moon_180548.txt (500 frames captured in its Duration of 27.602 s); the AVI header states 18.000 fps
mare.frameTimeMeaning: nominal, not measured: the start time in FireCapture's log Moon_180548.txt (Date, Start, and Start(UT)) plus the frame's number at the frame rate, which spreads the frames evenly over the log's Duration
mare.scope: the application's default detector settings except K, with darkening on and no large darkening; a fresh detector per variant and K from the first frame; no evidence written
